sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cryogenic Stainless Steel Pipe Welding and Insulation Contracting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic code; heavily harmonized with EU regulations; unitary national RCS/RNE registry system with no sub-tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-Hong Kong SAR Agreement for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (1997)
France-China Bilateral Agreement for the Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 1984, entered into force 1985)
France-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1967, as amended by the 2009 protocol)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.561-1 et seq., in particular Articles L.561-10, L.561-10-2, L.561-45 and L.561-46; Code de commerce, Articles L.123-1, R.123-4 to R.123-18; Décret n° 2020-115 du 11 février 2020 (fichier des bénéficiaires effectifs); Décret n° 2019-966 du 17 septembre 2019 (UBO annual filing); Arrêté du 21 février 2020 (format de la déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs); EU Directive (EU) 2018/843; EU Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 (cash controls).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (RBE/INPI register accessible to TRACFIN, judicial authorities, and ACPR; restricted legitimate-interest access for other stakeholders; not open to the general public following CJEU C-37/20 and C-601/20)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation / legal existence of any non-French corporate shareholder (extrait du registre équivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the issuing State's competent authority; where apostille is not recognized, French consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized/certified true copy of the constitutional documents of each non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or commercial registry in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus sworn translation into French by a translator approved by the French courts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney of the French representative / incorporator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the shareholders' residence or jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization, followed by certified French translation if executed in a non-French language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid national identity document or passport of the proposed manager and of each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport or identity authority of the relevant country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true copy with apostille or consular legalization, plus certified French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing screening of each manager, incorporator, and beneficial owner against: (i) EU consolidated financial sanctions list and EU CFSP asset-freezing designations; (ii) UN Security Council consolidated list and UNSCR sanctions regimes; (iii) French Direction générale du Trésor 'gel des avoirs' list; (iv) OFAC SDN List as a risk benchmark for USD settlements using L/C and SWIFT; and (v) PEP databases and TRACFIN/FATF guidance. CDD files must be prepared under CMF Articles L.561-5 and L.561-5-2. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory if any UBO is a politically exposed person under CMF Article L.561-10-2.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and INPI Registre National des Entreprises (https://data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be entered in Latin characters in the RNE. French statutory filing documents must be in French. If the chosen name is not in Latin script, a certified transliteration into French/Latin alphabet is required. The name must be distinguishable in the RNE, must not be identical or deceptively similar to existing RCS names or protected marks, and must comply with public-policy and linguistic rules under Code de commerce Article R.123-18.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: République, État, Ministère, Préfecture, Mairie, Officier public, Commissaire du gouvernement
Banque, Financement, Crédit, Épargne, Assurance, Courtier, Intermédiaire (regulated financial terms requiring prior ACPR authorization)
Société Anonyme, SA, SAS (if not legally constituted in that exact form)
Fondation, Chambre de commerce, Bourse de commerce, Ordre (reserved to accredited public or professional institutions)
Official French or EU flags, coats of arms, or acronyms suggesting state authority such as TRACFIN, ACPR, AMF
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a stand-alone pre-incorporation name reservation system; availability is checked at RNE/RCS filing. If the registrar refuses the name because of conflict or a non-compliant token, the applicant may immediately file a corrected online dossier via the Guichet unique. A formal recours administratif préalable may be filed with the Director of INPI under the CRPA, and any adverse administrative decision is appealable to the Tribunal administratif within two months under Code de justice administrative Article R.421-1. A prior French trademark right confers a 10-year monopoly and enforceable protection; the drafting lawyer should include alternate names in the incorporation deed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only where a professional domiciliation provider registered under Code de commerce Articles L.123-11-2 and R.123-202 is used, and where actual management records and decision-making remain accessible in France. A virtual office alone is insufficient commercial substance for a construction contractor; French tax and labor authorities may re-qualify the registered office for VAT and corporate income tax purposes if no operational capacity can be evidenced.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% quantified probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 36 months for a medium-risk, foreign-UBO SARL active in industrial piping; DREETS and URSSAF may inspect health/safety and employment records; tax audit authority may inspect equipment, tooling, and site supervision under the livre des procédures fiscales Article L.16 B.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name and brand clearance search against RNE, RCS, INPI trademarks, and Infogreffe database
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; flat fee for search of one to two names and conflict opinion

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL); Decree No. 2021-1620 of 9 December 2021 on the Guichet unique; Article L.123-33 and R.123-232 et seq. on RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (or Tribunal judiciaire mixte) in the department of the registered office, acting through the INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 (declaration of creation of a legal entity) together with the duly signed articles of association ('statuts'), publication certificate of the legal announcement, proof of registered-office domiciliation, and capital deposit certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital. Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and at least 20% paid up at incorporation, the balance within 5 years; in-kind contributions are fully paid up at incorporation. All cash contributions are deposited in a blocked account at a bank or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and released only after RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned incorporators, acting as the provisional shareholders, hereby unanimously resolve as follows: (1) the draft Articles of Association submitted to this meeting are adopted, constituting the SARL with share capital freely fixed at the subscribed amount; (2) each subscriber accepts the allotment of shares against contributions set opposite their name; (3) the registered office shown in the Articles is adopted; (4) Gérant is appointed manager without limitation of authority to manage the company, open bank accounts, sign contracts, and attain all permits, and is granted power to execute the formation filing; (5) the manager is authorized to apply for the industrial, environmental and occupational licenses required for cryogenic piping activities. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of articles of association and partner identity verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI - Registre National des Entreprises (name search); notary public (optional authentic deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the RNE to reserve the corporate name, check prior marks, and draft the French 'statuts' showing the free share capital, share allocation, manager, registered office, and corporate purpose limited to cryogenic piping installation. Have each partner sign the articles; if a partner contributes real property or specifically protected rights, retain a notaire to execute an authentic deed.
required_dossiers: Signed statuts (authentic or under private seal)
Valid identity documents of each partner and manager
Domicile certificate of registered office
Ultimate beneficial owner declaration under Article L.561-45 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate name is challenged, withdraw and reserve an alternative name or obtain the challenger's written consent; amend the statuts accordingly and re-submit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital deposit of cash contributions in a blocked account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC) or any French bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary non-interest-bearing account in the proposed company's name and deposit the amount of subscribed cash contributions. Request an attestation de blocage des fonds certifying that funds are unavailable until RCS registration. If no cash capital is paid in, produce a written waiver declaration signed by all partners.
required_dossiers: Final draft statuts
Identity of each cash subscriber
Detailed list of subscriptions and whether in cash or in-kind
Proof of in-kind valuations or commissaire aux apports report if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank refuses issuance of the certificate, request release and re-deposit with another EU bank or CDC; correct names and amounts before re-initiation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of legal notice in a journal d'annonces légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal gazette (JAL) of the registered-office court district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the announcement content containing the denomination, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate object, manager, and court of registration. Obtain the original publication certificate from the publisher after the statutory publication period.
required_dossiers: Draft announcement text
Identity and criminal record/declaration of non-conviction of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL publishes incorrect data, require immediate errata insertion and obtain a corrected publication certificate; file only after correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing with the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI - Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the INPI portal, complete the M0 declaration, upload all documents, and pay the applicable registry fee. The declaration must be signed by the manager or a duly authorized agent. Enter the activity under APE/NACE 43.22 and describe the cryogenic LNG receiving terminal piping installation works. The portal performs formal validation and transmits the dossier to the Greffe.
required_dossiers: M0 declaration of creation
Signed statuts
Certificate of publication in an authorized JAL
Attestation de blocage des fonds
Proof of registered-office domiciliation
Power of attorney if filing through an agent
Declaration of the manager's good standing and absence of criminal prohibitions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the online dossier is queried, review the INPI error notification, correct or re-attach the rejected documents within the specified period; if the defect is substantive, close the dossier and file a corrected one.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and delivery of Kbis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (or Tribunal judiciaire mixte) of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Allow the registrar to conduct the legality review of the statuts and attachments, then register the SARL in the RCS and issue an extrait Kbis. The Kbis is the official proof of legal existence and contains the SIREN, APE code, manager, date of registration, and share capital.
required_dossiers: Automatically transmitted dossier from the Guichet unique
Domiciliation justification if requested by the Greffe
Receipt of fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a project refusal or observations, respond with written explanations and corrected documents within the allowed period; if the refusal is maintained, appeal before the commercial court in accordance with the Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques, and INSEE
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After delivery of the Kbis, verify the automatic creation of the SIRET. Register as an employer with URSSAF, complete corporate income tax registration, confirm VAT status with the competent tax office, and engage a statutory auditor only if the legal size thresholds are exceeded.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
SIRET allocation notice
Identity of the manager
Bank account details
Domicile document and consent of the designated representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF or DGFIP identifies an APE code mismatch, request a correction through the INPI/RNE process; if a late filing penalty is threatened, file an application for remission under the grace-period provisions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for professional and environmental certifications for cryogenic piping work
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DREAL - Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement; DRIEETS for occupational health; recognized notified body (e.g., Bureau Veritas, APAVE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange assessment of welders and welding procedures under EN ISO 9606-1 and ISO 3834-2 to obtain a company qualification certificate for cryogenic stainless steel piping. If a fixed prefabrication workshop will be used, file any required ICPE declaration or registration with the DREAL. Submit the workplace fire-safety and ATEX zone classification plan to the local authorities and obtain structural and electrical inspection reports.
required_dossiers: Kbis and RNE extract
Welding procedure specification and procedure qualification records
Welder certificates
List of hazardous substances and work equipment
ICPE declaration or authorization form if threshold is reached
Fire safety and electrical inspection reports
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the qualification audit identifies non-conformities, correct them within the audit report timeline and request re-audit of the affected procedure; if DREAL queries the dossier, supplement with design codes and welding standards and seek a pre-ruling confirmation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), with Direction Générale de l'Énergie et du Climat (DGEC) for gas pipeline matters and DRIEETS for occupational safety
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Professional qualification certification for cryogenic stainless steel pipe welding under ISO 3834-2 and EN ISO 9606-1; if the company itself constructs or modifies natural-gas transport pipelines, authorization under the pipeline safety regulation of Arrêté du 5 mars 2015; where a fixed workshop exists, ICPE declaration or registration under the Environmental Code.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique - Direction Générale de la Prévention des Risques (DGPR) / DREAL
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally registration or declaration tier under ICPE nomenclature for metal welding and mechanical workshops if installed power exceeds thresholds; a full EIA report is triggered only when the project creates a new permanent LNG facility or a new pipeline route, in which case the terminal operator or project owner carries the authorization application; the contracting SARL must nonetheless provide environmental compliance documentation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For a fixed workshop, comply with ICPE Ministerial Order of 2 February 1998 discharge limits: pH 5.5-8.5, COD 120 mg/L, suspended solids 35 mg/L, mineral oil 10 mg/L; comply with solvent/VOC thresholds under Decree No. 2001-178 transposing Directive 1999/13/EC; all welding fumes extracted at source and hazardous waste such as abrasive dusts and used filters disposed of with a Bordereau de Suivi de Déchets Dangereux (BSDD).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification from the local SDIS or approved inspection body, structural load inspection certificate from an independent bureau de contrôle, ATEX zone classification, evacuation plan, and workplace clearance for work at height, confined spaces, cryogenic cold burn risks, and heavy mobile plant operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); online portal: impots.gouv.fr; business tax and VAT registration via the local Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-French entities must first assess whether they have a permanent establishment in France. For an established branch, a SIREN/SIRET number is obtained through the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). VAT registration is completed by filing Cerfa form n°15185*05 'demande d'attribution d'un numéro TVA intracommunautaire' with the competent SIE, attaching proof of incorporation in the home jurisdiction, identity of legal representatives, a description of French business activities, and an expected French turnover declaration. If the foreign entity is established outside the European Union, a fiscal representative enjoying active mandatory status is generally required. Upon validation, DGFiP issues the French intra-community VAT number (FR + key + SIREN).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not operate a check-the-box election system. SARLs are default subject to corporate income tax at entity level. Available elections include: (i) option for integration fiscale (French tax consolidation) under CGI Articles 223 A et seq. for groups holding at least 95% of subsidiaries; (ii) option to form a VAT group (assujetti unique) for closely-linked French established taxable persons; (iii) under CGI Article 239 bis AB, certain closely-held and family SARLs may elect partnership-style transparency, causing profits to be taxed at shareholder level; and (iv) hybrid mismatch neutralisation elections applicable under the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive implementation. A non-resident owner of a French SARL may be treated as a transparent entity under bilateral tax treaty tie-breaker provisions only if the OECD hybrid rules so require, but this remains an exception, not a routine check-the-box mechanism.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For French-established enterprises: €85,000 annual turnover for sales/disposal of goods and €37,500 for providers of services (some activities have reduced thresholds). Non-established foreign suppliers are liable to register from the first euro of taxable supplies with place of supply in France, subject to reverse-charge or Simplified Registration relief. Cross-border distance sales of goods to French final consumers trigger registration at the €10,000 Union-wide distance-sales threshold if the seller has not availed itself of the One-Stop-Shop regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for B2B transactions is being phased in under French law: from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-size taxpayers and from 1 September 2027 for small and medium taxpayers. Invoices must be transmitted through a certified dematerialisation platform (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire, PDP) or the public portal Chorus Pro, and invoice data must be transmitted to DGFiP via real-time structured data exchange using Factur-X/UBL formats. B2C cross-border and domestic sales are subject to mandatory e-reporting. France does not employ a real-time fiscal clearance model with digital stamping; instead, it relies on certified platform API transmission and clearance by the tax authority through Chorus Pro.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically dispatched or transported outside the European Union qualify for the 0% VAT rate under CGI Article 262 I, provided the exporter holds satisfactory evidence of exportation and the transfer of ownership passes to the non-EU purchaser. For services, certain services directly related to exported goods may be zero-rated under Article 262 II, but LNG receiving terminal piping installation performed in France constitutes immovable property work and is normally subject to French VAT at 20%. Export zero-rating is claimable only when the goods are removed from the EU within the statutory time limits and the exporter maintains a complete evidence file demonstrating dispatch and receipt outside the EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Déclaration en Douane des Marchandises, DDX) with the Export Administrative Reference (AAR) number assigned by French customs
Bill of Lading signed by the carrier or CMR waybill/air waybill proof confirming physical dispatch from France to a non-EU destination
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a French bank evidencing settlement of the export proceeds by the non-resident customer
Commercial invoice, packing list, supply/purchase orders, and the exporter's proof of payment receipt showing consistency of value and destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export VAT files are subject to rigorous audit scrutiny; the French tax administration has a standard four-year reassessment window, extended to six years for certain situations and up to ten years for concealed activities. Failure to substantiate zero-rating or export refund claims can lead to retrospective VAT clawback of the entire unrecovered amount plus late payment interest of 0.20% per month. Negligent inaccuracies attract a 40% penalty; bad faith or fraudulent documentation triggers an 80% penalty. Criminal tax fraud may be prosecuted under CGI Article 1741, carrying up to seven years' imprisonment and a €750,000 fine, in addition to administrative publication and prohibition-of-trading sanctions. Rejected refund claims may further trigger irrebuttable presumptions of intentional suppression and civil liability for any advisor involved.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting with the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR - Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) for banking supervision and with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) for balance-of-payments and foreign exchange statistical reporting under the Code monétaire et financier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France, as a eurozone member state, maintains full liberalisation of both current-account and capital-account convertibility for transactions between residents and non-residents of the European Union and of third countries. There is no prior administrative authorisation or foreign-exchange visa for inbound equity contributions, trade payments, loan repayments, or profit remittances by an SARL, provided that the transactions comply with EU sanctions regulations and French AML/CFT rules. Profits distributed by the SARL to foreign shareholders are freely convertible and transferable, but are subject to the domestic 25% dividend withholding tax unless reduced by an applicable double-tax treaty; transfer restrictions arise only from targeted sanctions, anti-money-laundering red flags, or the documentary obligations imposed by the French balance-of-payments monitoring framework. No separate convertibility certificate is required, yet the reporting threshold of €750,000 per transaction or aggregated annual flows triggers mandatory statistical declarations to the Banque de France.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory surrender requirement and no fixed conversion ratio for export proceeds. A French resident SARL may elect to hold export receipts in foreign currency within a domestic multicurrency account or convert them into euros at commercially negotiated rates. However, under the French balance-of-payments reporting regime, all cross-border settlements arising from exports of goods (including cryogenic piping installation services and related materials) must be declared to the Banque de France and the Direction Générale du Trésor through the authorised intermediaries when the cumulative annual amount of flows subject to reporting exceeds €750,000. Declarations must be submitted monthly (or quarterly for eligible corporates) with the precise nature-of-operation codes corresponding to the underlying commercial contract; failure to file is punishable under article R153-9 of the Code monétaire et financier. There is no statutory timeline for repatriation, but prudent treasury policy for ISIC_4322 projects should align collection dates with milestone payment schedules under the LNG terminal contract.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with dedicated trade finance and FX desk

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (Crédit Agricole CIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account / Commodity and Trade Finance mandate
Operational Account and FX/derivatives clearing facility
Operational Account and Construction Guarantee (caution bancaire) line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Restricted and conditional: EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) passporting into France under PSD2 may provide multicurrency IBAN accounts, SEPA and SWIFT-like payment rails, and FX conversion, but they cannot lawfully grant credit, issue documentary credits, or provide first-demand guarantees, all of which are essential for the target LNG terminal piping contract (LC-backed milestones and performance bonds). Non-EU offshore digital banks and EMIs without a valid EU passport cannot lawfully provide payment services to a French SARL; engagement creates ACPR supervision gaps and elevated correspondent-bank freezing risk. Overall feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium for small vendor payments and contingency liquidity; unsuitable and not recommended as the primary treasury counterparty for ISIC_4322_01 cross-border trade settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a French SARL with non-resident shareholders and a non-resident gérant, French ACPR-regulated banks uniformly require at least one in-person interview of the legal representative before account activation. Remote video on-boarding under the French PVID (Présentation à Vidéo Interaction à Distance) regime is accepted in limited cases only for natural persons possessing French identity documents or a strong eIDAS-certified e-identification; it is not accepted as a complete substitute for the first corporate account opening where the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) resides outside the EEA. The practical mandate is: personal appearance of the gérant, presentation of the original extract Kbis (or apostilled certificate of incorporation for a company in formation), identification of all shareholders with a 25% or greater interest, verification of the UBO register (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) filed with the INPI, certified corporate documents of the non-resident shareholders, and a documented source-of-funds narrative for the initial capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO in a non-EEA jurisdiction with an opaque or multi-layer corporate chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents of each shareholder; INPI extract evidencing the French UBO register filing; official beneficial-ownership register extract from the shareholder's home jurisdiction; corporate organisation chart; 12-month source-of-funds bank statements of the UBO; signed declaration confirming no nominee or straw-owner arrangements; negative-media and sanctions screening report; current tax-residence certificate of the UBO; audit trail of the initial capital deposit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry profile (ISIC 4322 cryogenic piping and insulation contracting) with disproportionate milestone receipts and subcontractor cash flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed LNG terminal piping/insulation contract with the project owner; UCP 600-compliant draft sale or works contracts; bilans of estimated future invoicing; subcontractor register with trade registry extracts and tax clearance certificates; attested employer declarations to URSSAF; external accountant's engagement letter and three-year liquidity forecast; compliance policy for the French corporate duty of vigilance (devoir de vigilance); if applicable, ISO 3834-2 or EN 13480 welding certification evidencing a controlled industrial framework.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital contribution exceeding the mandatory minimum with cross-border wire from a parent company or an individual shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised minutes of the SARL general meeting approving the initial subscription or capital increase; French bank blocked-capital attestation or notary escrow certificate covering the statutory 3-month retention for a company in formation; list of subscribers and respective amounts; source-bank verification letters; proof of origin of funds (dividends, disposal deeds, salary certificates, loan agreements); sworn statement on absence of third-party funding without consideration; commitment to disclose any subsequent shareholder current-account advances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border FX payments to suppliers or related parties in high-risk or sanctions-adjacent jurisdictions for procurement of cryogenic steel pipes and insulation materials
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts stating Incoterms, payment milestones, and delivery maturity; proforma invoices with precise goods descriptions, HS/CN codes, and customs valuation; transport documents (CMR, Bill of Lading, or Air Waybill); end-use and country-of-destination statement for the procurement; confirmation of absence of sanctioned parties or dual-use export-control concerns; completed banking sanctions questionnaire (questionnaire gel des avoirs); UBO declaration of the supplier where company-owned; agreement to provide full transactional audit trail and updated documents at each new large disbursement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the French SARL must be routed through a dedicated capital escrow account (compte bloqué pour la constitution) opened with a French bank or a notary in the name of the company in formation. The remitter's wire must identify the corporate or individual shareholder and the nature of the operation with the Banque de France balance-of-payments transaction code corresponding to 'apport en capital' under the category 'investissements directs' (French RCB protocol reference where applicable). Euro transfers from EU shareholders use the SEPA Credit Transfer, while non-euro injections require a SWIFT MT103 with the ISO 20022 purpose code and explicit reference to the SARL and the subscription minutes. The French bank verifies the amount, remitter identity, date, and legal basis against the notarised subscription minutes before issuing the attestation de blocage; for foreign shareholders, the outgoing bank's KYC file, a source-of-funds letter, and a copy of the apostilled corporate resolutions of the shareholder must accompany the wire to prevent rejection or prolonged AML review. For funds exceeding the statutory threshold or of high-risk provenance, the French bank will additionally request a sworn affidavit on the origin of funds and an extract of the shareholder's official registry.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are executed through: (i) SWIFT MT103 direct wire transfers for open-account supplier payments, with mandatory supplementary information (bank-to-bank instructions) in fields 70/72 and the applicable Banque de France nature-of-operation code; (ii) Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit issued by the French account-holding bank governed by UCP 600 and eUCP, paying the supplier of cryogenic pipes or insulation subcontractor against presentation of transport documents, insurance certificates, and inspection reports; (iii) SEPA Credit Transfers for eurozone vendors; and (iv) standby letters of credit and first-demand on-demand bank guarantees providing performance and advance-payment bonds to the LNG terminal project owner. For non-EEA beneficiaries, the bank performs sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence on the underlying export licence where the piping may fall within dual-use control lists. Multicurrency accounts in USD, CNY, and GBP may be opened to avoid double conversion, and the French bank may require the SARL to maintain sufficient euro liquidity as collateral for the LC and guarantee issuance lines.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forward foreign exchange contracts (currency forwards) with maturities up to 12 to 18 months, permitted only with a documented underlying commercial exposure in USD, CNY, GBP, NOK, or KRW arising from the LNG piping procurement and milestone invoices.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies without active onshore deliverable markets, notably CNY, KRW and certain frontier-currency exposures, traded with the French bank under an EMIR-regulated ISDA or long-form FX master agreement as a non-financial counterparty below the clearing threshold.

Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps for project-finance-linked hedging of simultaneous euro-cost and foreign-currency-revenue flows, permitted only as a hedge with an economic nexus and subject to ISDA/CSA collateral documentation.

Vanilla European-style currency options (call or put) for asymmetric protection of a specific bid or milestone conversion, permitted for non-financial counterparties as hedging and subject to MiFID II product-governance and appropriateness requirements.

Prohibited or restricted instruments: leveraged or exotic structures including target redemption forwards, accumulators, barrier options and any speculative open position not matched to an underlying commercial exposure; an SARL without a dedicated board-approved treasury mandate and the required risk assessment cannot execute such products at ACPR-regulated French banks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Meeting (AGO) approval of annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company statutory records (not filed with a government agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for 31 December year-end, no later than 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors become liable for failure; any interested party may apply to court to force convocation; late approval likely triggers late filing penalties for accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dépôt des comptes annuels (annual financial statements filing at RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS via French guichet unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval; if AGO held on 30 June, due by 30 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to €7,500 for a legal entity; court may impose astreinte; registration documents blocked until filing completed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Déclaration n° 2065 and annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year entities: e-file by the second working day after 1 May; non-calendar year-ends: within 3 months of year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-filing penalty of tax due (40% after 30-day formal notice; 80% for fraudulent failure); monthly 0.2% late-payment interest; automatic assessment if no return

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO register accuracy confirmation / update (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Event-driven: within 30 days after any share-transfer or control change; annual confirmation is made with accounts filing if data changes or public register is queried
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal AML sanction for managers (up to 6 months' imprisonment and €18,000 fine); legal entity also liable; registry further filings may be refused until corrected

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) payment and correction statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual payment by 15 December of the tax year; new establishments file initial form 1447-C within 3 months of commencement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 0.2% monthly interest; enforced collection may suspend legal remedies

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when it exceeds two of three thresholds: total balance sheet €4,000,000; net revenue €8,000,000; average steady employees 50. Additional triggers: parent/controlled-company relationships, shareholder request representing at least 1/3 of capital, or court order.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (PCG, ANC Regulation 2014-03 amended), consistent with EU Directive 2013/34/EU. IFRS is not the statutory framework for individual accounts; consolidated accounts of listed groups may use IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a separate annual UBO 'renewal'. The beneficial-owner declaration is due at incorporation, must be amended within 30 days of any share transfer or control change, and must be kept accurate when the company files annual accounts. Share transfers must be entered in the Share Register (Registre des mouvements de titres) and UBO data updated for the anti-money-laundering layer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors/Managers (Registre des décisions du gérant)
Minute Book (Livre des procès-verbaux des assemblées)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - 18,000 per year depending on balance-sheet complexity and group exposure

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit for SMEs with turnover below EUR 10 million, fully paid-up share capital, and qualifying shareholding; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% up to EUR 100 million of R&D expenditure and 5% above; EU/domestic loss carry-forward is indefinite but annual deduction is capped at EUR 1 million plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carry-forward; statutory annual cap applies)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (Déclaration de résultat) with liasse fiscale attachments submitted electronically through the impots.gouv.fr professional space or EDI/teleprocessing partners
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return; four quarterly advance CIT instalments and one final settlement
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December: file by the second business day following 1 May. For a fiscal year ending on any other date: file within three months of the fiscal year closing date. Advance instalments fall due each year on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December; final tax due with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: legal name, SARL legal form, SIREN, SIRET, NAF/APE code (ISIC 4322 equivalent for LNG terminal piping), registered office address, and fiscal year opening/closing dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No special entry for non-resident shareholders; the SARL is the French tax resident filer. If the company has a foreign principal establishment, attach a separate statement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income for the fiscal year (bénéfice fiscal) before deduction of loss carry-forwards and tax credits, determined under French GAAP adjusted by CGI rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the reported profit reflects arm's length pricing on all cross-border contracts with the foreign parent, LNG EPC contractors, or affiliate pipe suppliers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss for the fiscal year (déficit fiscal). If entered, the loss is available for indefinite carry-forward subject to the annual EUR 1 million/50% cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses cannot be allocated to a non-resident shareholder; the loss remains at SARL level and may be carried forward or, where eligible, carried back one year up to EUR 1 million.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and deductions (e.g., CIR, CICE reinvestment, foreign tax credits) that reduce the gross corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the CIR, document eligible cryogenic piping R&D activities physically performed in France; the R&D benefit is not attributable to the non-resident parent merely because it finances the work.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross corporate tax at 25% (or reduced 15% band) after offsetting instalments, plus balance payable or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The final balance is payable through the e-cash payment system; ensure the SARL's bank account and DTA/TRC details are accurate where the foreign parent claims refundable credits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge on the tax deficiency; after formal notice, the surcharge rises to 40%, and to 80% for abusive manipulation. Late-payment interest accrues at 0.20% per month. Non-electronic filing carries a EUR 150 fine. Intentional omission alone may also constitute tax fraud with criminal penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% withholding tax on dividends paid by a French SARL to non-resident corporate shareholders under CGI article 119 bis 2; 12.8% withholding tax applies to dividend distributions to non-resident individuals.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The foreign corporate recipient must apply for a French Form 5001 residence certificate (TRC) from its own tax authority and submit it to the French paying entity before the dividend payment date. For the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption, the parent must demonstrate a qualifying shareholding of at least 10% held for an uninterrupted two-year period. Where the full statutory withholding has been applied, a refund claim must be filed with the competent French tax authority (DRFIP) within three years of the date on which withholding was assessed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: French domestic law generally imposes no withholding tax on arm's length interest or royalties paid to non-resident companies. Payments to entities in non-cooperative States may attract anti-avoidance withholding at higher rates. Under the EU Interest and Royalties Directive, qualifying associated companies holding at least 25% of the payer for two years may receive interest and royalties free of withholding. DTA rates typically reduce royalties to 0%–10% and interest to 0% or 10% depending on the treaty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full French Master File and Local File documentation is mandatory where either the French SARL or the consolidated worldwide group has an annual turnover or balance-sheet total exceeding EUR 400 million (CGI article L13 AA). Country-by-Country Reporting is required where the consolidated group revenue reaches EUR 750 million. Below these thresholds, arm's length documentation must still be prepared on request for all related-party transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply Gulf-Cooperation-Council-style Economic Substance Regulations. However, the French general anti-abuse rule (abus de droit), the business purpose doctrine, and anti-artificial arrangement rules require the SARL to demonstrate real economic substance, personnel, risks, and strategic control in France. A shell French entity used in LNG terminal piping operations risks recharacterisation, denial of treaty benefits, and an 80% penalty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully concealing taxable income by issuing false invoices for cryogenic piping works, omitting cash payments, inflating construction costs, or booking personal expenses of the gérant as corporate deductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of 40% or 80% on the underpaid tax plus monthly late-payment interest. Criminal conviction: fine of EUR 500,000 and up to five years' imprisonment; aggravating circumstances (use of offshore accounts, organised fraud) increase penalties to EUR 3,000,000 and seven years' imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant may be prosecuted as direct perpetrator; if the corporate veil is pierced, the gérant is jointly and severally liable for the SARL's unpaid tax, interest, and penalties. A travel ban, asset freezing, and confiscation orders may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining the French SARL without developed economic substance, solely as a conduit for LNG receiving terminal piping contracts, with the aim of shifting profits out of the non-resident parent's residence State or avoiding French taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax administration may disregard the corporate arrangement under the abuse-of-law doctrine; all related profits are recharacterised in France, with an 80% penalty plus late-payment interest. Treaty benefits may be denied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign sham contracts or refuse to adjust transfer pricing risk joint personal liability for the tax and penalties; criminal sanction for abuse of law may include disqualification from managing companies, asset confiscation, and imprisonment in proven fraud cases.
